questions.q: The number of bacteria in a petri dish was 1,20,000. It increased by 10% in the first hour and changed by x in the second hour. In the third hour, it increases by 10%. If the current number is 1,16,160, then determine the change in population in the second hour.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dhyan se dekh. Pehle aur teesre ghante me $10\%$ ka increment hai, par final population $1,20,000$ se gir kar $1,16,160$ ho gayi hai. Iska seedha matlab hai ki beech me ek bhayankar drop aaya hoga. Reverse calculation marna yaha sabse fast hack hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ulta chalna shuru kar! Final value $1,16,160$ tab mili jab teesre ghante me $10\%$ ka increment (yaani $\frac{11}{10}$ multiplier) lag chuka tha. Toh isko wapas reverse karke second hour ke end ki value nikal le.

Mathematically :-
$$11 \rightarrow 1,16,160$$
$$10 \rightarrow 1,16,160 \times \frac{10}{11} = 1,05,600$$
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,32,000$$
$$\text{Decrease} = \frac{1,32,000 - 1,05,600}{1,32,000} \times 100\% = 20\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Seedha successive ka formula laga, aur unknown multiplier ko $t$ maan le. Ek line ki equation me sab set ho jayega.

Mathematically :-
$$1,20,000 \times \frac{11}{10} \times t \times \frac{11}{10} = 1,16,160$$
$$1,45,200 \times t = 1,16,160$$
$$t = \frac{1,16,160}{1,45,200} = \frac{4}{5}$$
$$1 - \frac{4}{5} = \frac{1}{5} = 20\% \text{ drop}$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab initial aur final values given ho, aur intermediate change pucha jaye, toh Method 1 (Reverse scaling) lagaya kar, calculation me time bachega!

Trick / ConceptApplication
Reverse Unit Scaling$\times \frac{\text{Old Base}}{\text{New Ratio}}$

questions.q: In a solution the quantity of common salt in 320 gm water is 31 gm. Calculate the concentration % of the solution in context of mass by mass percentage.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total mass $320 + 31 = 351$ gram ban raha hai. Ab $351$ ka $10\%$ seedha $35.1$ hota hai. Apna solute sirf $31$ gram hai, jo $35.1$ se thoda sa hi kam hai. Iska matlab apna answer $10\%$ se thoda sa kam aayega. Options me sirf ek hi aisi value hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bina pen uthaye approximation ka jaadu chala aur option uda de!

Mathematically :-
$$\frac{31}{351} \approx \frac{31}{350} \implies 9\% \text{ se thoda kam} \implies 8.83\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic formula laga solute upon total solution ka, par thoda calculative padega.

Mathematically :-
$$\frac{31}{31 + 320} \times 100 = \frac{31}{351} \times 100 \approx 8.83\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Exact division karke decimal me time barbaad karna sabse badi bewakoofi hai, denominator dekhte hi approximation marna seekh!

questions.q: Population of a city X is 4,25,000. In the next three years, there is a total increase of 12% in male population and increase of 20% in female population, which results in male to female ratio as x:y. If the original male and female population of the city is 2,50,000 and 1,75,000 respectively, then find the value of (4x+5y).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, in bade zeros se apni dosti khatam kar le. Original Male ko $250$ aur Female ko $175$ maan le. Aakhiri me ratio hi toh nikalna hai, zeros toh waise bhi cut jayenge. Male ko $12\%$ aur female ko $20\%$ se badha de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha naya ratio likh aur di gayi equation me value daal ke answer nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$M_{new} = 250 \times 1.12 = 280$$
$$F_{new} = 175 \times 1.20 = 210$$
$$x:y = 280:210 = 4:3$$
$$4(4) + 5(3) = 16 + 15 = 31$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar poore zeros ke sath majdoori karni hai toh ye kar le, par time jayega.

Mathematically :-
$$M_{new} = 2,50,000 \times 1.12 = 2,80,000$$
$$F_{new} = 1,75,000 \times 1.20 = 2,10,000$$
$$x:y = 2,80,000:2,10,000 = 4:3$$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio nikalte waqt extra zeros ko dimag me hi uda dena chahiye, yahi best time saver technique hai.

questions.q: An ore contains 25% of an alloy that has 90% iron. Other than this, in the remaining 75% of the ore, there is no iron. How many kilograms of the ore are needed to obtain 60 kg of pure iron?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, poore ore me loha kahan se aa raha hai? Sirf uss $25\%$ wale hisse se. Aur usme bhi pura loha nahi hai, bas uska $90\%$ hai. Toh seedha net percentage nikal le iron ka.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Overall iron ka percentage nikal aur seedha usko $60$ ke barabar rakh de!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Net Iron} = 25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%$$
$$X \times 22.5\% = 60$$
$$X = \frac{60}{0.225} = \frac{60,000}{225} = 266.67$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le Total Ore $100x$ hai aur basic steps follow kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Alloy} = 25x$$
$$\text{Iron} = 90\% \text{ of } 25x = 22.5x$$
$$22.5x = 60 \implies x = \frac{60}{22.5}$$
$$100x = 100 \times \frac{60}{22.5} \approx 266.67$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage of percentage dikhe toh hamesha unhe multiply karke ek single net percentage bana liya kar, bahut time bachega.

List IList II
Net Iron %$25\% \times 90\% = 22.5\%$

questions.q: The price of petrol shot up by 5%. Before the hike, the price was Rs. 82 per litre. A man travels 3045 km every month and his car gives mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the increase the monthly expenditure (to the nearest Rs.) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol in prices?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, gadhe bachhe pura purana kharcha nikalenge aur phir naya kharcha nikal ke minus karenge. Apne ko smart banna hai! Sirf 'increase' pucha hai, toh sirf 'increased price' wale difference pe dhyan de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Petrol ki extra badhi hui keemat nikal aur seedha total consumption se multiply mar de!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Extra Rate} = 82 \times 5\% = 4.1$$
$$\text{Total Litres} = \frac{3045}{15} = 203$$
$$\text{Extra Exp.} = 203 \times 4.1 = 832.3 \approx 832$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Old expenditure aur New expenditure alag alag nikal ke minus kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Old Exp} = 203 \times 82 = 16,646$$
$$\text{New Exp} = 203 \times 86.1 = 17,478.3$$
$$\text{Difference} = 17,478.3 - 16,646 = 832.3$$

Exam Takeaway: Hamesha direct difference (delta) par kaam kar, faaltu me absolute values calculate karke time kharab mat karna.

questions.q: In an examination, (A + 6)% of the students failed in Mathematics and (A - 8)% failed in Science. 28% of the students failed in both the subjects. If the percentage of students who passed in both the subjects was 50%, then what is the value of A?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total bachhe humesha $100\%$ hote hain. Jo dono subjects me pass hue wo $50\%$ de rakhe hain, toh iska matlab jo kisi na kisi ek me (ya dono me) fail hue wo total $100 - 50 = 50\%$ honge. Seedha set theory yaad kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Universal set wala formula laga aur equation turant solve kar de!

Mathematically :-
$$n(M \cup S) = n(M) + n(S) - n(M \cap S)$$
$$50 = (A + 6) + (A - 8) - 28$$
$$50 = 2A - 30 \implies 2A = 80 \implies A = 40$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn diagram ke logic se only math aur only science ke fail nikal ke total bana le.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Only Math} = (A + 6) - 28 = A - 22$$
$$\text{Only Sci} = (A - 8) - 28 = A - 36$$
$$\text{Total Fail} = (A - 22) + (A - 36) + 28 = 2A - 30$$
$$2A - 30 = 50 \implies A = 40$$

Exam Takeaway: Har baar Venn diagram draw karne me time barbaad mat kiya kar, seedha union wala set formula dimag me rakha kar!

List IList II
Total Union$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$

questions.q: A stock portfolio consists of four stocks. Stock A represents 10% of the portfolio and has a return of 4%. Stock B represents 20% of the portfolio and has a return of 8%. Stock C represents 30% of the portfolio and has a return of 3%. Stock D represents the remaining 40% of the portfolio and has a <u>negative-return</u> of 6%. What is the average return of the portfolio?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan portfolio ke alag alag hisso ko unke returns se seedha multiply karna hai. Positive wale add honge aur jisme nuksan (negative) hai wo subtract hoga. Aur total base humesha $100\%$ ka weight rahega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Weights aur returns ki values ko direct multiply karke jodd de aur seedha $100$ se divide maar!

Mathematically :-
$$10(4) + 20(8) + 30(3) + 40(-6) = 40 + 160 + 90 - 240 = 50$$
$$\text{Avg Return} = \frac{50}{100} = 0.5\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard weighted average ka proper formula laga ke calculation kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\frac{w_1r_1 + w_2r_2 + w_3r_3 + w_4r_4}{w_1+w_2+w_3+w_4} = \frac{40+160+90-240}{100} = 0.5\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Weighted average nikalte waqt negative values pe dhyan se nazar rakhna, wahan silly mistake ke chances bahut zyada hote hain.

List IList II
Weighted Sum$\frac{\Sigma (Weight \times Return)}{\Sigma Weight}$

questions.q: If 65% of 350 - ?% of 250 + 40% of 120 = 158, then find the value of ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, equation ko tukdo me tod ke simplify kar. $40\%$ of $120$ toh bacchon wala khel hai, seedha $48$ aayega. $65\%$ of $350$ thoda sa calculative lag raha hai par isko decimal $0.65 \times 350$ likh kar solve kiya ja sakta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Percentage ko decimal me convert kar aur direct equation solve maar!

Mathematically :-
$$350 \times 0.65 = 227.5$$
$$48 - 2.5x + 227.5 = 158$$
$$275.5 - 2.5x = 158 \implies 2.5x = 117.5$$
$$25x = 1175 \implies x = 47$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar calculations me phans raha ho toh Digital Sum (C9) technique se option verify kar liya kar.

Mathematically :-
$$65\% (DS=2) \times 350 (DS=8) \rightarrow 16 \rightarrow 7$$
$$40\% (DS=4) \times 120 (DS=3) \rightarrow 12 \rightarrow 3$$
$$158 \rightarrow DS=5$$
$$7 - 7x + 3 = 5 \implies 10 - 7x = 5 \implies 7x = 5$$
$$7(2) = 14 \rightarrow 5 \implies x=47$$

Exam Takeaway: Digital sum wahan chipkaya kar jahan normal calculation tera extra time kha rahi ho.

questions.q: If the first number is 15% less than the third number and the ratio of the second and third numbers is 3 : 5, then by what percentage is the average of the first and third numbers more than the second number?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sabse best aur safe tareeka hai ki Third number ko seedha $100$ maan le. Isse tera base set ho jayega aur saari calculations makhan ki tarah smooth ho jayengi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base ko $100$ maan aur direct ratio shift karke values nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$T = 100 \implies F = 85$$
$$S:T = 3:5 \implies 5u = 100 \implies 1u = 20 \implies S = 60$$
$$\text{Avg}(F,T) = \frac{85+100}{2} = 92.5$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{92.5-60}{60} \times 100 = \frac{32.5}{60} \times 100 = 54.16\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar $x$ aur $y$ jaise variables me khelega toh algebric equation banayega aur time gawayega.

Mathematically :-
$$z = x, \ y = 0.85x, \ y:z = 3:5 \dots$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi percentages aur ratios mix hokar exam me aayein, toh hamesha common element ko $100$ ka multiple maan liya kar.

questions.q: A solution of sugar and milk contains 26% sugar by weight. After boiling, 63 kg milk evaporates and the solution now contains 40% of sugar. Find the original quantity of solution?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, boil karne par hamesha paani ya doodh hi udata hai, cheeni wahi ki wahi rehti hai. Jo solid part hai wo humesha constant rahega. Bas yahi dimaag laga kar single equation banani hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jo cheez constant hai (sugar) usko dono taraf equate kar aur ratio nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$26\% \times O = 40\% \times N$$
$$O:N = 40:26 = 20:13$$
$$\text{Evaporated} = 7u = 63 \implies 1u = 9$$
$$\text{Original} = 20u = 20 \times 9 = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation method jisme initial quantity ko $x$ maan kar solve karte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$0.26x = 0.40(x - 63)$$
$$0.26x = 0.40x - 25.2$$
$$0.14x = 25.2 \implies x = 180 \text{ kg}$$

Exam Takeaway: Mixture ke sawalo me jo cheez evaporate nahi hoti ya add nahi hoti, hamesha wahi constant hoti hai aur usi ko equate kiya kar!

List IList II
Solid Constancy$P_1 \times Q_1 = P_2 \times Q_2$

questions.q: In Veeru Bhai Pvt. limited company 60% of the employees are men and 48% of the employees are engineers and 66.66% of these are men. The percentage of women who are <u>not</u> engineers:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab aise percentages of percentages me exam setter khel raha ho, toh total employees ko aankh band karke $100$ maan le. Language ki trap ye hai ki base kiske reference me pucha gaya hai, wo dekhna bahut zaroori hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total $100$ leke branches bana aur jo manga hai wo seedha nikal!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Total} = 100 \implies \text{Men} = 60, \text{Women} = 40$$
$$\text{Total Engg} = 48$$
$$\text{Men Engg} = \frac{2}{3} \times 48 = 32$$
$$\text{Women Engg} = 48 - 32 = 16$$
$$\text{Non-Engg Women} = 40 - 16 = 24$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Galti se usko total employees ($100$) se divide mat kar dena. Language ke hisaab se denominator sirf women hongi.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Base} = 40 \text{ (Total Women)}$$
$$\text{Percentage} = \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage kiske 'respect' me pucha gaya hai (yaani Base kya hai), usko exam paper me hamesha underline kar liya kar!

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, milkman ko sirf apne kharche pe overall $20\%$ profit chahiye. Usko is baat se koi matlab nahi ki kitna doodh kharab hua hai, usko bas aakhiri revenue nikalna hai bache hue doodh se.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total revenue target set kar aur bachi hui quantity se divide maar de, answer teri aankhon ke samne hoga!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Target Revenue} = 2000 \times 1.2 = 2400$$
$$\text{Remaining Qty} = 50 - 5 = 45$$
$$\text{Selling Rate} = \frac{2400}{45} = 53.33$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Per unit cost wagera nikal ke bewakoofo ki tarah solution complicate mat karna.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{CP per L} = 40 \implies \text{Logic fails here without total target}$$

Exam Takeaway: Seedha target total revenue nikal aur remaining quantity se divide kar de. Profit/Loss me quantities destroy hone wale questions ka ye best hack hai!

questions.q: In a speed test a student got 30% marks and failed by 25 marks. In the same speed test another student got 40% marks and secured 25% marks more than the essential minimum marks. Then max. marks set for speed test?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dono situations me Passing Marks (PM) humesha same hi honge. Dono data points ko utha ke bas Passing Marks ke reference pe le ja kar equate kar dena hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Passing marks ko apna common anchor bana aur dono conditions ko takra de!

Mathematically :-
$$PM_1 = 30\% + 25$$
$$1.25 \times PM_2 = 40\% \implies PM_2 = 32\%$$
$$30\% + 25 = 32\% \implies 2\% = 25$$
$$100\% = 25 \times 50 = 1250$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic variable ($M$) leke basic algebra laga ke equation solve kar.

Mathematically :-
$$0.4M = 1.25(0.3M + 25)$$
$$0.4M = 0.375M + 31.25 \implies 0.025M = 31.25 \implies M = 1250$$

Exam Takeaway: Pass/Fail marks wale questions me ek single reference equation banakar percent ko marks se equate kar liya kar.

questions.q: For a number, greater than one, the difference between itself and its reciprocal is 20% of the sum of itself and its reciprocal. By how much percentage (nearest to an integer) is the square of the number less than its cube?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, language thodi ghumau hai par basic algebraic equation ban rahi hai. Cross multiply karke seedha number ka square nikal lena sabse asaan hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation ko fraction ki tarah set kar, solve karke cube aur square ka ratio nikal de!

Mathematically :-
$$x - \frac{1}{x} = 0.2\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right) \implies \frac{x - \frac{1}{x}}{x + \frac{1}{x}} = \frac{1}{5}$$
$$5x - \frac{5}{x} = x + \frac{1}{x} \implies 4x = \frac{6}{x} \implies x^2 = 1.5$$
$$x = \sqrt{1.5} \approx 1.2247$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{x^3 - x^2}{x^3} \times 100 = \left(1 - \frac{1}{x}\right) \times 100$$
$$\left(1 - \frac{1}{1.2247}\right) \times 100 \approx (1 - 0.816) \times 100 \approx 18.3\% \approx 18\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute values pe ja kar cube nikalega aur square nikalega toh decimals me jaakar puri tarah fass jayega. Seedha ratio utha.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{A-B}{A} \times 100 = \left(1 - \frac{B}{A}\right) \times 100$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage less/more pooche algebra me toh hamesha unka ratio $\frac{A}{B}$ form me convert kar lo, original absolute values ki tension khatam ho jayegi.

List IList II
% Less of A wrt B$(1 - \frac{A}{B}) \times 100$

questions.q: If decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x% then x% of 720 is what percentage more than (x+15)% of 200? (Round off to the nearest integer)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedhi si baat hai $120$ ko ghata rahe ho aur $40$ ko badha rahe ho aur dono same level pe aa rahe hain. Linear equation banegi jahan se $x$ chutki me nikal aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle relation se $x$ ko paka aur direct second statement me put karke percentage gap nikal!

Mathematically :-
$$120\left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) = 40\left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right) \implies 3(100 - x) = 100 + x$$
$$300 - 3x = 100 + x \implies 4x = 200 \implies x = 50$$
$$\text{P1} = 50\% \times 720 = 360$$
$$\text{P2} = 65\% \times 200 = 130$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{360 - 130}{130} \times 100 = \frac{230}{130} \times 100 \approx 176.9\% \approx 177\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation ko fraction banake variables solve karne ka basic step.

Mathematically :-
$$120(1 - x) = 40(1 + x) \dots$$

Exam Takeaway: SSC Mains ke exams me aisi 2-step problems bahut aati hain. Target hamesha step 1 se variable nikal ke jaldi step 2 me daalna hota hai bina ruke.

List IList II
Percentage Gap$\frac{\text{Diff}}{\text{Base}} \times 100$

questions.q: The total cost of 5 pens and 3 notebooks is 130. If the cost of pen is decreased by 25% and that of the notebook is increased by 10% then total cost of 3 pens and 2 notebooks will be 67. what is the total original cost (in Rs) of 6 pens and 4 notebook?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, linear equations wale sawaalo me decimals aur fractions sabse bade dushman hote hain. Inko sabse pehle gayab kiya kar ke exact whole numbers banaya kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation set kar, multiplier laga kar decimals hata, aur ek variable udakar answer nikal de!

Mathematically :-
$$5P + 3N = 130$$
$$3(0.75P) + 2(1.1N) = 67 \implies 2.25P + 2.2N = 67$$
$$\text{Multiply by 20 } \implies 45P + 44N = 1340$$
$$\text{Multiply Eq1 by 9 } \implies 45P + 27N = 1170$$
$$17N = 170 \implies N = 10 \implies 5P = 130 - 30 \implies P = 20$$
$$6P + 4N = 6(20) + 4(10) = 120 + 40 = 160$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables leke normal elimination kar, bas decimal me fasne se bacha lena khud ko.

Mathematically :-
$$2.25P + 2.2N = 67 \times 100 = 225P + 220N = 6700$$

Exam Takeaway: Decimal equations dikhte hi unhe turant 10, 20 ya 100 se multiply karke whole numbers me le aaya kar, aadhi calculation mistakes wahi khatam ho jayengi.

questions.q: A man started off a business with a certain capital amount. In the first year, he earned 40% profit and donated 14.28% of the total capital (initial amount + profit). He followed the same procedure with the remaining capital after the second and the third year. If at the end of the three years, he is left with 4320, what was the initial amount with which the man started his business?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts)

Pen-Free Observation: Bhai jab bhi ek hi procedure har saal same tareeke se repeat ho raha ho, seedha compounding method lagta hai ek solid multiplier banakar. Dhyan rakhna $14.28\%$ ko turant $\frac{1}{7}$ soch lena chahiye warna decimal mar dalega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ek saal ka net multiplier frame kar aur aakhiri saal tak uski power laga ke initial amount nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Profit Mult} = 1.4$$
$$\text{Donation Left} = 1 - \frac{1}{7} = \frac{6}{7}$$
$$\text{Net Multiplier per year} = 1.4 \times \frac{6}{7} = 1.2$$
$$C \times (1.2)^3 = 4320$$
$$C \times 1.728 = 4320 \implies C = \frac{4320}{1.728} = 2500$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har saal alag alag amount calculate karega toh puri class me tu hi fail hoga. Basic algebra waha fail hoti hai.

Mathematically :-
$$C \rightarrow 1.4C \rightarrow 1.4C - \frac{1.4C}{7} \dots$$

Exam Takeaway: Successive increase/decrease cycles me fractions ka single multiplier banaya kar aur time frame ke hisaab se power laga diya kar.

questions.q: Suresh decides to donate 46.67% of his monthly salary but later he donates 4900 which is 22.22% less than the amount he planned to donate earlier then find the monthly income of Suresh.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ajeeb aur khurafati percentages dekh kar darna nahi hai. Inko hamesha unke chote base fractions me tod. $46.67\%$ ko dimag me $40\% + 6.67\%$ dekhna shuru kar de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Un fractions ko split kar aur single fractional equation banake seedha answer utha la!

Mathematically :-
$$46.67\% = \frac{2}{5} + \frac{1}{15} = \frac{7}{15}$$
$$22.22\% \text{ less} = 1 - \frac{2}{9} = \frac{7}{9}$$
$$\text{Income} \times \frac{7}{15} \times \frac{7}{9} = 4900$$
$$\text{Income} = \frac{4900 \times 15 \times 9}{49} = 100 \times 135 = 13500$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ le kar pure decimal values me math khelega toh paper chhut jayega tera.

Mathematically :-
$$0.4667x \times (1 - 0.2222) = 4900 \dots$$

Exam Takeaway: Aise non-standard percentages ko hamesha fraction values me tod ke solve kiya kar, kabhi galti nahi hogi.

questions.q: A stationary supplier ordered 8 boxes of premium pens and some boxes of standard pens. The price of premium pens per box was twice that of standard pens. When the order was delivered, the number of boxes of premium and standard pens had been accidentally interchanged. This increased the total bill by 25%. What was the ratio of the original number of premium pens to the original number of boxes of standard pens? (CGL TIER I - 13/09/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, price ka ratio $P:S = 2:1$ given hai. Quantity $P=8$ aur $S=x$ hai. Interchange hone ki wajah se poora bill $25\%$ uchhal gaya. Yaha equations ko end tak lamba kheechna bewaqoofi hai, options ka sahara sabse badhiya shortcut hota hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ek step ki equation bana aur cross-check ke liye sidha ratio nikal le!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Orig Value} = 8(2) + x(1) = 16 + x$$
$$\text{New Value} = x(2) + 8(1) = 2x + 8$$
$$1.25(16 + x) = 2x + 8 \implies \frac{5}{4}(16 + x) = 2x + 8$$
$$80 + 5x = 8x + 32 \implies 3x = 48 \implies x = 16$$
$$\text{Ratio } P:S = 8:16 = 1:2$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se reverse check kar aur apna value bitha ke dekh le, seedha 15 second bachenge.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Try Option } 1:2 \implies S = 16$$
$$\text{Orig} = 16+16=32, \ \text{New} = 32+8=40$$
$$\text{Increase} = \frac{8}{32} = 25\% \text{ (Condition Matched)}$$

Exam Takeaway: Interchange wale complex language problems me option plugging hamesha sabse tez aur khatarnak hathiyar hota hai.
